title: Finding the Status of Your Requests
body:
Finding the Status of Your Requests

You can check the status of your requests to see when they're fully approved, or to find out when you'll receive the items or service. You can also find the request history to find if the order was sent to the supplier.

Context

Consider the following when you search for a request:

  • Items are sorted by the date they were last changed.

  • Requests that are in Ordered, Receiving, or Received status display one or more purchase order numbers. Click these numbers to display complete information about an order, such as the status of each line item; for more information, see Finding POs.

  • When there are multiple purchase orders associated with individual requisitions, fewer than 200 results may display in Your Requests.

  • If there are many line items, guided buying displays only the first 200. If there are more than 100 comments, guided buying indicates there are too many comments to display.

Procedure

  1. On the home page, choose Your requests.
  2. Scroll through the list of all types of requests (All), find the Quotes or Custom forms list, or filter by date. You can also use the Find a request search box to locate a request by one of the dropdown options: Request ID, Order ID, Request title, Supplier ID, or Supplier name. When using the search filters, the search returns any request that contains the searched string of text.
  3. Choose the request number or title to open it.
  4. For requests, review the Approval Flow section to find the progress in the approval process, as shown in the following figure.
    Approval Flow diagram with no approvals

    In the following figure, the first approver is highlighted because the request is being reviewed. After it's approved, the node in the approval flow changes to a checkmark.

    Approval Flow diagram with one approval
    Tip

    If the first approval node remains in Pending status after you submit a requisition, approvers can't act on the request. To allow users to act on requisitions in Pending status, enable the parameter Activate first pending approval node for requisitions. This parameter sets the first approval node to Active status, thus allowing approvers to take action.

    For quotes, review the Process or Invited suppliers sections to find the progress in the approval process. In the following figure, a message displays below the approval process to indicate the status.

    Process diagram for a quote
  5. Scroll down to the History section to find out more information about who submitted, edited, or approved the request.
    Note

    The History section also tells you whether and when the order made it to the supplier.

  6. Use the Optional comment box to request an update from an approver, or check Share with supplier and add a comment to send information to the supplier.
